references.text: Korah, son of Izhar, is mentioned here as the leader of the rebellion against Moses and Aaron, confirming his lineage from Exodus 6:21.
The descendants of Korah are listed in the census, with reference to Korah's rebellion. Verse 11 confirms that Korah's sons did not die.
Korah's lineage through Izhar is confirmed here in the genealogy of the tribe of Levi, showing the connection to temple service.
Korah, son of Izhar, is mentioned as part of the tribal register of Levi, confirming the genealogy from Exodus 6:21.
Highlights Korah's role as the ancestor of a distinct lineage within the family of Levi.
Correctly places Izhar in Kohath's lineage and confirms his identity as the brother of Amram, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Confirms Izhar's identity and position in Kohath's genealogy (parallel to verse 6).
Further confirmation of Izhar's place in Kohath's lineage with the number of sons.
